name: SnakeGame.Live
summary: SnakeGame.Live is an online multiplayer snake game featuring dragon-like snakes in a colorful arena. Players collect food to grow, use speed boosts, avoid other snakes and environmental obstacles, and compete for the highest position on the leaderboard. The game supports mouse controls on desktop and touch controls on mobile browsers.
